programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: In Our Prime [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang Woo is left with his grandmother in a remote village while his mother looks for work. Born and raised in the city, Sang Woo quickly comes into conflict with his old-fashioned grandmother and his new rural surroundings. Disrespectful and selfish, Sang Woo lashes out in anger, perceiving that he has been abandoned. He trades his grandmother's only treasure for a video game; he throws his food and he throws tantrums. When Sang Woo's mother finds work and finally returns for him, Sang Woo has become a different boy. Through his grandmother's boundless patience and devotion, he learns to embrace empathy, humility, and the importance of family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: Icon of early talking pictures, Harry Carey (Red River), portrays the rugged Trigger Carson, a noble cowboy who infiltrates an outlaw gang in order to expose their rackets. Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

Ordered to kidnap a young girl, his identity is revealed and he is forced to fight his way out of the gang and back to safety. Already 56 by the time he signed on to do this and a series of Westerns for Berke Productions, the stately Carrey (who netted an Oscar nomination four years later) was widely lauded at the time for adding a great deal of maturity and respectability due to his undeniable presence and strong performances.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Cesar Millan’s Leader of the Pack
programme.desc: Cesar welcomes a broken pack to the ranch and helps the pet parents overcome past trauma so they can move forward united. Getting a little help from DPC trainers, Cesar turns a dangerous pit bull into a well-balanced dog who can provide help in an emergency. The pet parents of a famous Yorkie seek help from Cesar to get his frantic behavior under control before they start a family.

Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: In Our Prime [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Seven-year-old Sang Woo is left with his grandmother in a remote village while his mother looks for work. Born and raised in the city, Sang Woo quickly comes into conflict with his old-fashioned grandmother and his new rural surroundings. Disrespectful and selfish, Sang Woo lashes out in anger, perceiving that he has been abandoned. He trades his grandmother's only treasure for a video game; he throws his food and he throws tantrums. When Sang Woo's mother finds work and finally returns for him, Sang Woo has become a different boy. Through his grandmother's boundless patience and devotion, he learns to embrace empathy, humility, and the importance of family.

With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Saltwater Experience
programme.desc:
In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.
As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.
With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Passe moi les jumelles S12
programme.desc: "Le musée Albert-Kahn dévoile le projet humaniste du banquier. Parfois appelée « la plieuse de temps », Simone Pheulpin travaille le ruban de coton. Pour son premier défilé chez Dries Van Noten, Julian Klausner se joue des textures et des couleurs. L'air de la plage gagne l'atelier de Sophie Brillouet."
